name: Freedom Fighter (PFS)
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
body:
Drawbacks
Freedom Fighter (PFS)
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
Category Faction
Your family has long waged war against tyranny, and you learned a great deal about guerilla warfare in your youth. You gain a +1 trait bonus on Stealth checks and a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls made during the surprise round.
